title: An IBM hexadecimal float is written as the normalised number of the format
description: -118.625 is -0.76A × 16^2: sign 1, exponent 64 + 2 = 0x42, fraction 76A000, bytes C2 76 A0 00. 1.0 is 0.1 × 16^1: 41 10 00 00, the normalised form, not the 42 01 00 00 a stream may also spell it. -0.0 is a zero fraction and a zero exponent under the sign: 80 00 00 00. In 64 bits 1.0 is 41 10 then six zero bytes.
